Settlement_Services.Framework.Defs.Settl.label: deathrest
Settlement_Services.Framework.Defs.Settl.description: Leave a pawn with an active deathrest gene in a settlement's basic deathrest chamber for one unassisted four-day cycle. It restores 80% of the deathrest need (up to the maximum), clears deathrest exhaustion and interrupted-deathrest sickness, and ends old deathrest building bonuses. It grants no new building bonuses and does not change hemogen.
